analyst_view.overall: Fifth-placed Real Sociedad (22 points) host sixth-placed Sevilla (19 points) on Sunday night, so a Sevilla win would draw them level with a direct rival for the European places; the numbers lean to a home win with about 2.9 goals. Pellegrino Matarazzo's side lost 3-2 at Racing last Sunday and played Crystal Palace away in the Europa League on Thursday night, so they get three days' rest after a trip to London, which the numbers don't count. Barrenetxea and Yangel Herrera are out and now counted, Odriozola is out with a knee injury, one report says Álex Marchal is suspended, Sucic is over his illness and Aramburu (hip) may return. Luis García Plaza's Sevilla, who drew the derby 1-1 with Betis, miss Carmona, Alfon González and Miguel Sierra, with Marcão back in training, and are expected to name much the same side. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, now already taking about 10% off Real Sociedad for Barrenetxea and Yangel Herrera, which they did not count when I last wrote. What they still can't see is the Thursday night trip to Crystal Palace three days before, so I keep a small lean lower, about 2.8; Sucic being fit again keeps it small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 5.4 for Real Sociedad, already a little lower for their recent corners. Losing Barrenetxea takes width from the home side, but tired teams often defend deeper and concede more, and Sevilla's low recent corners against are already counted, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, 3.1 for Sevilla, already raised for Sevilla's 20 bookings in their last six. It is a game between rivals for the European places but not a derby, Agoumé and Juan Iglesias are reportedly close to a ban, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 5.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, already raised for both sides' busy recent shooting (+10.1% for Real Sociedad, +5.1% for Sevilla). Real Sociedad come off a Thursday night game in London with three days' rest, which usually takes some tempo out of the home side, so I lean a little lower, about 23.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, close to both sides' recent accuracy. The same short rest after the Europa League trip should take a few attempts off, though Oyarzabal and Oskarsson up front keep it a small move, about 8.0.
